title: Dual Variational Neural Network for the $p$-Laplace Problem
summary: The reliable and accurate numerical approximation of the $p$-Laplacian is particularly challenging in the extreme regimes $p \to 1^{+}$ and $p \gg 1$, where the operator becomes either highly singular or strongly degenerate, often causing severe instability in standard numerical methods. To address these difficulties, we propose a novel deep learning based framework, termed the dual variational neural network, for $p$-Laplace problems.
